title: Driver Pay Schedule 2: Wait, Toll, Airport, Long Pickup and Reservation Rates
content:
Beyond time-and-distance pay, a completed trip under **Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro** can carry add-on pay at the rates in this schedule. Every rate here is the same at every Wayfare Pro status: Wayfare Pro Blue, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond and Diamond Elite.

## 2.1 Wait pay per billable wait minute (USD per minute, every status)

| Ride option | Driver wait rate |
|---|---|
| Wayfare Shared | 0.20 |
| Wayfare Standard | 0.28 |
| Wayfare Green | 0.28 |
| Wayfare Comfort | 0.36 |
| Wayfare XL | 0.40 |
| Wayfare Black | 0.62 |
| Wayfare Black SUV | 0.74 |

## 2.2 Shares and pickup rates (every status)

| Item | Rate |
|---|---|
| Share of each toll charged to the rider that is paid to the driver | 100% |
| Share of airport access fees paid to the driver | 0% |
| Original pickup estimate above which long pickup pay applies | 10 minutes |
| Long pickup pay per estimated pickup minute above that threshold | 0.24 USD per minute |
| Share of a reservation fee paid to the driver who completes the reserved trip | 50% |

## 2.3 Points of reading

- **Airport access fees.** At a 0% share no part of an airport access fee is driver pay.
- **Long pickup threshold.** Long pickup pay counts only the estimated pickup minutes above 10. A hypothetical original pickup estimate of 10 minutes earns no long pickup pay; an estimate of 14 minutes earns pay on 4 minutes, 0.96 (0.24 for each of the 4 minutes).
- **Reservation fee.** A hypothetical reservation fee of 5.00 paid by the rider on a reserved trip carries a driver share of 2.50 at 50%.
- **Tolls.** At 100%, a hypothetical toll of 3.25 charged to the rider is paid to the driver as 3.25.
